note: Score each expected_behavior line independently. These are authored evaluations, not executed results.

scenarios.title: Scenario-first feature
scenarios.query: Design a cancellation flow that offers retention but never traps the user.
expected_behavior: Grounds the affected persona and job before screens
Maps success, cancel, failure and return states
Writes traceable scenarios with observable outcomes
Keeps integration and visual choices at their own boundaries

scenarios.title: As-built UX audit
scenarios.query: Check the current onboarding implementation against its scenario set.
expected_behavior: Treats scenarios as the source of expected behavior
Reports file:line evidence for code findings
Separates absent scenarios from implementation defects
Produces a fix plan without silently changing the product

scenarios.title: Brand and copy
scenarios.query: Calibrate a voice for a developer tool, then rewrite its error and empty states.
expected_behavior: Reads or creates the brand contract before drafting copy
Keeps one voice with per-surface register changes
Names the failure and one recovery action in errors
Checks terminology and facts instead of inventing claims
